purpose: CTR-first professional YouTube thumbnail packaging, visual pattern intelligence, and thumbnail text intelligence system for Senior Health AI videos while preserving medical integrity.

concept_generation.unique_concept_requirement: Each concept must vary composition, text family, text wording, signal cue, facial expression, color emphasis, curiosity route, or title-overlap strategy.
concept_generation.winner_requirement: One winning thumbnail must be selected after all ten concepts are scored.

visual_pattern_intelligence.purpose: Analyze likely top-performing and common competitor thumbnail patterns for the topic before generating concepts, then deliberately create concepts that preserve CTR signals while avoiding clone-like similarity.
visual_pattern_intelligence.live_audit_policy: If live competitor thumbnails or search results are not provided, infer common competitor layouts from the topic, title, content DNA, thumbnail blueprints, and prior channel patterns. Label the result as an estimated visual-pattern analysis.

common_competitor_layout_types.name: doctor_food_warning
common_competitor_layout_types.description: Doctor or presenter beside a food plate with a red warning cue and large caution text.

common_competitor_layout_types.name: organ_closeup_alarm
common_competitor_layout_types.description: Large organ illustration, red circle, alarmed face, and fear-heavy wording.

common_competitor_layout_types.name: food_collage_list
common_competitor_layout_types.description: Multiple foods arranged as a crowded list or collage with numbers.

common_competitor_layout_types.name: fake_scan_or_lab_result
common_competitor_layout_types.description: Medical chart, scan, or lab-style result used as proof or urgency.

common_competitor_layout_types.name: green_check_red_x_split
common_competitor_layout_types.description: Split-screen safe versus unsafe comparison with check and X symbols.

common_competitor_layout_types.name: grocery_basket_confusion
common_competitor_layout_types.description: Senior shopper or grocery basket with many food items and uncertain expression.

similarity_scale.low: Concept uses a clearly different composition, hero-object relationship, eye path, or emotional mechanism from common competitor layouts.
similarity_scale.medium: Concept uses a familiar layout but adds a meaningful differentiator in framing, cue, object choice, or visual promise.
similarity_scale.high: Concept strongly resembles a common competitor layout and should be penalized unless it has exceptional clarity and safety.

differentiation_rules: Avoid competitor-clone layouts unless a distinct medical-safety or curiosity improvement is present.
Prefer one clear hero object over crowded food collages.
Prefer real food and human expression over fake medical proof visuals.
Use caution, question, or decision-point visuals instead of disease-outcome visuals.
The winning concept must include a short explanation of why it stands out from competitors.

thumbnail_text_intelligence.purpose: Maximize thumbnail text curiosity and click-through rate while ensuring text is specific to the viewer problem, title gap, research promise, and visual concept rather than generic or interchangeable.
thumbnail_text_intelligence.research_integrity_policy: Research integrity is a gate. Among medically safe options, select the highest ethical CTR option.

generic_text_restriction.allowed_only_if: The concept-specific visual gives the phrase a unique meaning and the agent explains why it is justified.

per_text_option_scoring.internal_question_rule: Every text must naturally create an internal question. If no internal question exists, lower the CTR score.
per_text_option_scoring.self_identification_rule: Evaluate whether the viewer imagines themselves in the situation. Score 0-10.

interchangeability_test.question: Could this same text fit ten unrelated senior-health videos?

text_overlay_specification.purpose: Give Production_Agent a complete, production-ready overlay treatment for the winning thumbnail text without requiring it to infer typography, placement, or mobile-safe layout.
text_overlay_specification.style_selection_policy: Do not hardcode one universal overlay style. Choose typography, colors, line breaks, placement, and hierarchy based on the winning concept, visual hook, selected thumbnail text, title overlap guidance, presenter position, hero object, and mobile readability.

medical_explainer_options: blue scrubs only if the reference already represents that persona and the project allows that persona

required_final_prompt_wording: Use the uploaded reference image only as the facial identity reference.
Recreate the presenter for this thumbnail.
Redesign clothing, pose, expression, camera angle, lighting, background, and accessories to match the concept.

categories.label: Emotional Trigger
categories.definition: Strength of immediate emotional response such as curiosity, relief, concern, surprise, or hope without unsupported fear.

categories.label: Mobile Visibility
categories.definition: Whether the face, food, signal cue, and text remain clear at small YouTube feed size.

categories.label: Curiosity Gap
categories.definition: How strongly the image creates an unresolved question without revealing the full payoff.

categories.label: Information Gap
categories.definition: How well the thumbnail adds a missing visual question or contrast instead of duplicating the title.

categories.label: Food Visibility
categories.definition: For food topics, whether the food hero object is instantly recognizable, appetizing, and dominant. For non-food topics, score the equivalent hero-object clarity.

categories.label: Human Face
categories.definition: Presence, size, expression, eye direction, and emotional clarity of a human face.

categories.label: Text Readability
categories.definition: Large, short, high-contrast text, usually 2 to 5 words, readable at small size.

categories.label: Color Contrast
categories.definition: Contrast between background, face, food, text, and signal cue.

categories.label: Competition Difference
categories.definition: How clearly the concept avoids blending into common competitor thumbnails or saturated visual tropes.

categories.label: Medical Safety
categories.definition: Whether the visual avoids cure claims, fake medical results, fear exaggeration, medication-change implications, and unsupported treatment imagery.

categories.label: Visual Uniqueness
categories.definition: How strongly the concept avoids common competitor layouts while remaining clear, relevant, and on-brand.

categories.label: Mobile Eye-Catch
categories.definition: How strongly the thumbnail grabs attention in a fast mobile feed through silhouette, focal contrast, face readability, text punch, and instant visual question.

scoring_model.calculation: raw_total_score = emotional_trigger + mobile_visibility + curiosity_gap + information_gap + food_visibility + human_face + text_readability + color_contrast + competition_difference + medical_safety + visual_uniqueness + mobile_eye_catch; normalized_score = round((raw_total_score / 120) * 100)

validation_rules.pass_condition: main food or hero object, face, signal cue, and thumbnail text remain readable at small feed size
composition guides the viewer from Face to Food to Arrow to Text
single visual story with no crowded backgrounds, excess icons, tiny labels, or multiple competing focal points
concept has a clear differentiator from common competitor thumbnails
thumbnail complements title and does not repeat more than 70 percent of the title or title keyword information unless justified by search intent
one food, body part, object, or visual class dominates the concept
a clear expressive human face is present unless a documented topic-specific exception exists
face shows clear curiosity, concern, relief, surprise, or confidence
text is short, high contrast, and usually 2 to 5 words
no cure symbols, fake before-after numbers, fake medical results, medication-change implication, frightening hospital imagery, or guaranteed outcome
concept has a clear differentiator from common competitor layouts and scores at least 7 in Visual Uniqueness to be eligible for winner selection
concept has a strong mobile-feed hook and scores at least 7 in Mobile Eye-Catch to be eligible for winner selection
each concept includes a Low, Medium, or High visual similarity estimate against common competitor layouts, with a short reason
pre-generation diagnosis and every per-concept text intelligence field are present
generic phrases such as ADD THIS, DO THIS, TRY THIS, WATCH THIS, STOP THIS, THIS WORKS, SECRET, AMAZING, or MUST SEE are absent unless a concept-specific justification is documented
thumbnail text does not repeat the selected title's main wording or reveal the same core information
thumbnail text is 2 to 4 words and readable on mobile
thumbnail text does not imply cure, guaranteed prevention, reversal, universal safety, diagnosis, or treatment replacement
no concept has HIGH interchangeability risk; revise generic or reusable text before scoring finalists
at least 5 distinct thumbnail text families are explored across the 10 concepts
every concept includes Option A, Option B, and Option C, and all three options are different
each text option is scored for Research Integrity, Medical Safety, Mobile Readability, Information Gap, Emotional Trigger, Internal Question, Self Identification, and Overall CTR Score
the recommended text winner for each concept does not have a lower Overall CTR Score than another medically valid option for that concept
generic wording such as ADD THIS, DO THIS, WATCH THIS, TRY THIS, or THIS WORKS is not selected as the winning text
every text naturally creates an internal question; if not, it is not selected and its CTR score is lowered
every text option includes a Self Identification score from 0 to 10
when a reference presenter image is available, the final prompt states that it is used only as the facial identity reference and that the presenter is recreated for the thumbnail concept
final prompt redesigns clothing, pose, expression, camera angle, lighting, background, and accessories for the concept instead of copying the reference composition
podcast equipment, headphones, desk, computer, boom arm, keyboard, coffee mug, office chair, and unrelated reference accessories are excluded unless the concept explicitly requires them
face, facial proportions, hairstyle, beard if present, eyebrows, skin tone, age appearance, and identity are preserved

the selected winning concept and final prompt include a Text Overlay Specification with final overlay text, line breaks, text placement, alignment, font style, font weight, font family recommendation, uppercase/lowercase, primary text color, highlight color if applicable, outline color, outline thickness, drop shadow recommendation, maximum text width, maximum text height, safe margins, mobile readability notes, do-not-overlap zones, visual hierarchy, and contrast recommendation

information_overlap_policy.goal: Minimize title and thumbnail information overlap while preserving search clarity.
information_overlap_policy.penalize_when: thumbnail repeats more than 70 percent of the title or title repeats more than 70 percent of thumbnail text and hero information
information_overlap_policy.reward_when: thumbnail adds a visual question, emotional cue, or contrast that the title does not already state

examples.title: Eat 2 Kiwis Before Bed After 60... What Happens?
examples.reason: The improved thumbnail keeps the hero object and curiosity without duplicating the full title.

winning_title_contract.selected_title_field_rule: Every selected_title/final_title_thumbnail_pairing field must use the exact project.json.anchor_title.
